activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 6 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: The report stated that demand would increase over the decade.
cards.explanation: Would es adecuado para una predicción incluida en un informe pasado.

cards.statement: The audience was about applauding when the actor returned.
cards.explanation: About to requiere to + infinitivo: was about to applaud.

cards.statement: He said the meeting will finish before lunch.
cards.explanation: En estilo indirecto se prefiere He said the meeting would finish.

cards.statement: We were going to book the cottage, but it was already full.
cards.explanation: Were going to presenta un plan pasado que no se realizó.

cards.statement: The captain announced that the ferry would depart at dawn.
cards.explanation: Would puede expresar una salida futura anunciada desde el pasado.

cards.statement: The delegation was going to arrive after the ceremony.
cards.explanation: Was going to arrive puede expresar un plan o expectativa pasada.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: She said the parcel would arrive on Tuesday.
cards.explanation: Would expresa el futuro desde el punto de vista de una declaración pasada.

cards.statement: The flight was due to leave at eight, but it was cancelled.
cards.explanation: Due to leave conserva el horario previsto aunque el vuelo se cancelara.

cards.statement: The engineer said the system would be ready by Friday.
cards.explanation: Would es la forma adecuada en este estilo indirecto.

cards.statement: The train was due leaving at 05:45.
cards.explanation: La forma correcta es was due to leave.

cards.statement: The plane was about to land when the alarm sounded.
cards.explanation: Was about to land indica una acción inminente en el pasado.

cards.statement: The speaker was about to announce the winner.
cards.explanation: Was about to announce expresa inminencia.

cards.statement: I was about to call the client when my laptop crashed.
cards.explanation: Was about to call describe la acción inmediatamente anterior.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: He expected the interview would be demanding.
cards.explanation: Expected puede introducir una expectativa con would.

cards.statement: They knew the decision would affect every department.
cards.explanation: Would presenta el efecto futuro desde knew.

cards.statement: We were going to cycle home, but the storm became worse.
cards.explanation: El contraste muestra un plan pasado que fue abandonado.

cards.statement: They knew the storm would affect the coastal villages.
cards.explanation: Would presenta un efecto futuro desde un momento pasado.

cards.statement: The ferry was due to leave at six.
cards.explanation: Was due to leave se refiere a un horario pasado previsto.

cards.statement: The timetable said the train was due arriving at 07:10.
cards.explanation: La forma correcta es was due to arrive, no was due arriving.

cards.statement: She said she would to return before sunset.
cards.explanation: Después de would usamos la forma base sin to: would return.

cards.statement: The committee was due publish its report on Monday.
cards.explanation: Due debe ir seguido de to: was due to publish.
